name: Autophagosome assembly in pexophagy and receptor-mediated organelle autophagy
rationale: Members cover phagophore assembly, ATG8 delipidation and positive regulation of autophagosome assembly in selective autophagy of peroxisomes, mitochondria and nucleus; pexophagy, nucleophagy and nitrogen response set it apart from PINK1-PRKN mitophagy, aggrephagy/CMA and reticulophagy neighbours.

qualifier: Th1 and regulatory T cell fates
name: CD4 T cell commitment to Th1 and regulatory lineages
rationale: All members promote IL-12/IFN-gamma-driven Th1 or Treg differentiation while suppressing Th2/Th17 fates, unlike neighbours centred on IFN-gamma response, dendritic/NKT cells or T cell inhibition.

name: G-CSF-driven neutrophil differentiation from myeloid progenitors
rationale: Members describe myeloid progenitor commitment to granulocytes/neutrophils with G-CSF signalling, distinct from eosinophil/mast, M-CSF macrophage and RUNX neighbours.

qualifier: fasting-responsive PGC-1alpha and circadian nuclear receptors
name: Fasting-responsive PGC-1alpha and circadian control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members link PGC-1alpha/PPARA, clock nuclear receptors, caloric restriction, redox and acetylation to gluconeogenesis and mitochondrial biogenesis, unlike pure circadian, NPAS4 or LXR lipid-homeostasis neighbours.

qualifier: M-CSF and G-CSF receptor cascades in granulocyte and macrophage development
name: Colony-stimulating factor receptor signalling in granulocyte and macrophage development
rationale: Members combine M-CSF, G-CSF and GM-CSF receptor signalling (incl. SHC interleukin signalling) with granulopoiesis, distinguishing it from CSF-production, RUNX/erythroid and eosinophil/mast neighbours.

name: RUNX-driven transcriptional control of granulocytic myeloid differentiation
rationale: Members centre on RUNX1/2/3 and VENTX transcription governing progenitor commitment to neutrophil, eosinophil and mast lineages, unlike monocyte/DC, M-CSF or erythroid-megakaryocyte neighbours.

name: Repair chromatin remodeling and NHEJ restraint at double-strand breaks
rationale: Members concern protein recruitment, ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodeling at DSB sites with negative regulation of NHEJ, unlike nucleosome-assembly neighbours or NHEJ/ATM sensing neighbours.

name: TLR2 sensing of bacterial lipopeptides and endogenous ligands
rationale: Members cover TLR2 responses to diacyl lipopeptide and lipoteichoic acid and TLR regulation by endogenous ligands, distinct from LPS/TLR4 and generic monocyte inflammation neighbours.

name: Amyloid-beta generation, retention and LTP suppression
rationale: Members promote amyloid-beta formation via ectodomain proteolysis, impede its clearance and suppress LTP, unlike neighbours on microglial activation, Abeta clearance or fibril formation.

name: Motile axoneme assembly in respiratory cilia and sperm flagella
rationale: Members build dynein arms, central apparatus and sperm axoneme/manchette for motile cilia and mucociliary clearance, unlike multiciliogenesis, left-right cilia, sperm mitochondrial sheath or tubulin-modification neighbours.

qualifier: BAF complex assembly plus apoptotic DNA fragmentation
name: BAF complex assembly and apoptotic chromatin dismantling
rationale: A composite of SWI/SNF BAF complex formation and apoptotic chromatin condensation, DNA fragmentation and lamina breakdown, distinct from nucleosome-assembly, necroptosis and PAK-2p34 neighbours.

qualifier: FGFR3 and FGFR1 adaptor cascades with feedback
name: FGFR3 and FGFR1 adaptor signalling and its feedback regulation
rationale: Members are FGFR3/FGFR1 ligand binding, FRS and SHC cascades plus Sprouty and bidirectional FGFR regulation, unlike FGFR2/FGFR4/Klotho and PLC-cascade neighbours.

name: Bidirectional regulation of BMP and TGF-beta SMAD signalling
rationale: Members positively and negatively regulate BMP and TGF-beta SMAD signalling, distinct from SMAD2/3 transcription, receptor-mutant and extracellular sequestration neighbours.

qualifier: von Willebrand factor-GPIb axis and its disease variants
name: Von Willebrand factor-GPIb platelet adhesion and its disease variants
rationale: Members cover VWF binding to GPIb-IX-V and collagen, ADAMTS13 cleavage and their variants, unlike basement-membrane, aggregation, coagulation or contact-pathway neighbours.

name: Iron-sulfur cluster assembly and ferredoxin electron supply
rationale: Members cover [2Fe-2S]/[4Fe-4S] assembly, TCA enzyme maturation and NADPH-ferredoxin electron transfer used in pregnenolone synthesis, unlike heme and respiratory-complex assembly neighbours.

qualifier: RNA processing, modification and mitoribosome assembly
name: Mitochondrial RNA processing, modification and mitoribosome assembly
rationale: Members span mitochondrial tRNA/rRNA/mRNA processing and modification, mitoribosome assembly and translation, unlike RNA import, pseudouridylation or mitochondrial RNA decay neighbours.

name: ERBB, MET and PTK6 tyrosine kinase signalling
rationale: Members cover ERBB/EGFR, MET/HGF, PTK6 and ALK/LTK signalling to PI3K-AKT, ERK and STAT3, distinct from FGFR/RAS-MAPK, EPO/IGF1R and EGFR-downregulation neighbours.

qualifier: helicase unwinding in the mitotic cycle
name: Mitotic DNA replication initiation and helicase unwinding
rationale: Members cover cell-cycle replication initiation, DNA unwinding, polymerase activation and break-induced replication, unlike E2F cell-cycle, ATR replication-stress or cell-division neighbours.

name: Promotion of structural synaptic plasticity and spine maturation
rationale: Members promote synapse maturation, spine morphogenesis, structural and long-term plasticity with local translation, unlike CREB/memory, postsynaptic actin/PSD or LTP/LTD calcium neighbours.

name: Osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in trabecular bone and tendon
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation with trabecular bone, tendon and proteoglycan synthesis, unlike intramembranous ossification, Wnt/MSC or mineralization neighbours.

qualifier: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and abscission
name: ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing and abscission in mitotic exit
rationale: Members cover ESCRT-III nuclear envelope reassembly, midbody abscission and cytokinesis/cohesion restraint at mitotic exit, unlike spindle, contractile ring and chromosome condensation neighbours.

name: Tyrosine and phenylalanine catabolism
rationale: Members are tyrosine/phenylalanine catabolism plus general L-amino acid catabolic terms, unlike glycine, threonine and histidine catabolism neighbours.

qualifier: NAD and coenzyme A for pyruvate dehydrogenase
name: NAD and coenzyme A supply for pyruvate dehydrogenase
rationale: Members cover nicotinate/NAD(P) and pantothenate/CoA metabolism with PDH acetyl-CoA production, unlike thiamine/riboflavin, OGDH/lipoylation or TCA neighbours.

name: Ryanodine receptor calcium release control in skeletal muscle
rationale: Members regulate ryanodine-sensitive SR calcium release and sequestration in skeletal muscle contraction, unlike cardiac, SERCA/exchanger and store-operated entry neighbours.

qualifier: OATP-mediated hepatic uptake of drugs and bilirubin
name: OATP-mediated hepatic uptake of drugs and bilirubin
rationale: Members are SLCO/OATP sodium-independent anion uptake, drug ADME and Rotor-type hyperbilirubinemia, unlike SLC22/cation, sulfonation/xenobiotic and UGT/heme-degradation neighbours.
